newsitem.title: USA: ANR opens Canada gas link with Consumers.
newsitem.headline: ANR opens Canada gas link with Consumers.

text.p: Coastal Corp's ANR Pipeline Co and Consumers' Gas Co said Friday that natural gas has begun to flow on the Link Project, a gas pipeline system that will increase transportation between the U.S. and Canada.
The project consists of two interconnected pipelines:
- The ANR Link, a 12-mile, 24-inch U.S. pipeline that runs from ANR's Muttonville Lateral in St. Clair, Michigan, to the international boundary on the St. Clair River.
- The Link Pipeline, a six-mile, 24-inch Canadian pipeline that runs from the international boundary to Consumers Gas' Tecumseh natural gas storage complex in Ontario.

The Link project allows natgas to flow via existing lines to Union Gas Limited at Dawn, Ontario, facilitating more downstream transportation service in eastern Canada and the northeastern U.S, ANR said in a statement.
Upstream in Michigan, the new pipeline connects with ANR's Muttonville storage field in St. Clair County and Michigan Consolidated Gas Co (MichCon) facilities near its Columbus Storage field.
ANR constructed, owns and operates all Link facilities in the U.S., while Niagara Gas Transmission, an affiliate of Consumers Gas, constructed, owns and operates the six-mile segment in Canada.
MichCon and Consumers Gas have signed long-term agreements to transport gas on the new pipeline, which has an initial capacity of 150 million cubic feet per day.
ANR Pipeline operates a 12,643-mile interstate natural gas pipeline system providing transportation, storage and capacity-related services in the U.S. and Canada.
Coastal Corp is a Houston-based energy holding company, with consolidated assets of more than $10 billion.
Consumers Gas of Toronto, one of Canada's leading energy companies, is the country's largest natural gas distributor, serving about 1.3 million customers, primarily in central and eastern Ontario.
IPL Energy in Calgary, operator of the world's longest crude oil and liquids pipeline system, holds an 85 percent interest in Consumers Gas.
